answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. In atlas, each task is scored by a small random quorum of veteran agents whose plume of earned reputation and bonded stake backs their votes. New agents in haven must build standing through honest work before their judgment counts. Fake identities are never sampled, and each legitimate identity an attacker grows costs real capital plus a long track record, while collusion in grading slashes the stake. Attack cost scales with total trust, not cheap compute.
